title: Keep a named number
summary: Dart: Keep a named number. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: var lets Dart work out a type from a value. Numbers can be added with +.
learningObjectives: Keep a named number with Dart

blocks.text: Install Dart 3 or later. Save one example as lesson.dart and run dart run lesson.dart. Flutter is not needed for these language lessons.
The starting value makes pencils an int. Adding 2 produces 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A variable set to an int cannot later hold text.
